campaigns.noteLine: Only clip footage from Vyro campaigns you have joined — joining a campaign is the permission to use its footage.
submitChecklist: Only post clips from a campaign you have joined on Vyro. Use only the footage that campaign names.
Post only on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or X. Facebook views do NOT count on Vyro.
Submit the post link on Vyro IMMEDIATELY after posting — views count from the moment you submit the link, not from when you posted.
Each post must reach 5,000 views on its own before it earns anything.
Do not delete the post while the campaign is running.
No duplicate reposting of the same clip, and no fake or botted views — both are Vyro violations.

campaigns.noteLine: Content Rewards (Whop) campaign — NOT Vyro. Join the campaign first; joining is the permission to use its footage. The 120-hour marathon ends when the stream ends, so this window is only a few days.
submitChecklist: Only clip footage from the Dylan Page GTA 6 marathon campaign you joined. Use only the footage the campaign names.
Dylan must be visible in the clip, and #DylanPage must be in the caption.
Rate $1.00 per 1,000 views — per clip minimum $10, maximum $250. Budget $5,000 (as of 18 Nov 2026).
Post only on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts. Submit the post link on Content Rewards within 30 minutes of posting — views count from submission, not from posting.
Do not delete the post while the campaign is running.
No duplicate reposting of the same clip, and no fake or botted views.
Remove GTA radio music — keep game sound + streamer's voice only. Licensed music brings a claim.
No story spoilers (mission endings) and no leaked footage — only released footage named in the brief.
Join karne se pehle campaign page pe final rate, bacha hua budget aur allowed platforms check kar lo — rates roz badalte hain.
